name: Claude Conversation Extractor
headline: Claude Conversation Extractor: Log Management
short_description: Extracts clean conversation logs from Claude Code's internal storage. Operations teams use it to backup and search chat history. Connects to CLI workflows and saves data in markdown format.
author: ZeroSumQuant

sections.overview:
Claude Conversation Extractor is the only tool that exports Claude Code conversations stored in ~/.claude/projects as JSONL files. It provides two interfaces—an interactive UI with real-time search (claude-start) and a command-line interface (claude-extract)—to extract, search, and backup your chat history in Markdown, JSON, or HTML formats. The tool runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux with zero external dependencies, automatically locating your Claude Code logs and converting them to readable archives. Use it to search through past conversations, backup sessions before deletion, or export detailed transcripts including tool use and MCP responses for documentation or knowledge sharing.
Backup all Claude Code conversations before they're accidentally deleted
Search through past Claude chat history to find solutions and code snippets
Export conversations to Markdown for team documentation and knowledge sharing
Convert Claude JSONL logs to JSON or HTML for programmatic processing and analysis
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ZeroSumQuant/claude-conversation-extractor`
sections.usage:
```
Extract conversation logs from Claude Code's internal storage for the date range [START_DATE] to [END_DATE]. Save the output in markdown format to [FILE_PATH]. Include metadata such as conversation ID, timestamp, and user inputs. Ensure the output is clean and ready for backup or analysis.
```
